channel.title: DevEraXTech: services and work
channel.description: DevEraXTech is a web design and development studio based in Cairo, Egypt, building secure, scalable, pixel-perfect websites, online stores, web and mobile apps, desktop software and AI integrations, with ongoing care plans, for clients in Canada, the United States, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt.

item.title: Nilora Estates: Luxury Real Estate Platform, Cairo
item.description: A full MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) platform for Nilora Estates, a private residential agency selling villas, penthouses and coastal homes across Cairo and the Egyptian coast. It has a cinematic public site plus three role-based dashboards: buyers save homes and book private viewings, agents manage their listings and leads, and admins control properties, advisors, users and content.

item.title: Karim Ahmed: Full-Stack Developer Portfolio Website
item.description: A personal portfolio website for Karim Ahmed, a full-stack MERN developer and the founder of DevEraXTech, based in Cairo. Its cinematic, darkroom and film-roll design presents featured projects such as a university events and facilities management platform, along with skills, work experience, private one-on-one teaching sessions and a contact form. It is built to be secure, accessible and fast, with no third-party trackers.
